scope: Public-question routing, selective capture, automatic evidence eligibility and truthful error/context reporting

diagnosis.cause: The personal-pronoun filter treated the trailing request framing 'I just want to know' as personal context. General model output then failed answer validation and surfaced as invalid_input.
diagnosis.historical_failures_retained: Recent persisted answer calls included invalid_input despite recorded completions and token usage. Raw provider outputs were not retained, so their exact rejected shape cannot be reconstructed.
diagnosis.previous_context: Automatic mode really serialized the complete eligible small collection into SOURCES and MEMORIES; the old Reviewed label described supplied context, not independently verified model comprehension. Saved no_memory chat sources inflated that context.

changes: Normalize request framing without erasing personal assertions or possessives.
Clear public questions with no lexical workspace match return not_saved and skip extraction; date questions also remain in the current chat.
Public routing checks workspace references locally but sends no workspace evidence to the provider.
Automatic context excludes completed no_memory chat sources unless they support claims; pending/failed learning and supporting antecedents remain eligible.
Existing source history is preserved. Personal/contextual and mixed messages retain selective extraction; assistant replies are never ingested.
The extractor explicitly distinguishes durable personal/project information from public trivia and one-response style requests.
Context counts say Sent to answer model. Invalid model outputs after repair surface as provider_response_invalid instead of blaming the user input.

checks.ruff_lint_and_format: passed; 55 Python files in documented scopes
checks.application_start: Existing demo API replaced with tested image and healthy; database preserved
checks.tooling_retries: An initial read-only audit referenced a nonexistent ModelCall.role field and was corrected to job_id. Initial Ruff cache writes were denied; checks passed with --no-cache. Neither was a runtime application failure.

cases.question: what is the capital of USA ? I just want to know the city and in which state it is present
cases.review: Answered Washington, D.C.; correctly explained that it is a federal district, not a U.S. state.

cases.question: how many planets are there in the solar system ?
cases.review: Answered eight and listed the eight planets.

cases.question: what is one of my favourite beverage ?
cases.review: Tea, retaining the feeling-good condition and citing the original note.

cases.question: For the fictional Willow project, I prefer SQLite for the prototype. What database do I prefer for Willow?
cases.review: Both cited answers preserved the prototype scope. Two original messages support one active learned memory; the repeat did not add a claim.

limits: Grammar and lexical routing is conservative and not an all-language semantic classifier. Ambiguous/entity/mixed messages can remain on the contextual capture path.
Personal questions still review a complete small collection for paraphrase recall, rather than claiming every selected note is directly relevant.
Existing sources were not retroactively deleted; explicit source retrieval and Sources can still inspect older question records.
Source history and learned memory are separate. Personal questions may be retained as history without any learned claim.
General answers are model knowledge, not live-web verified facts. These few live checks do not establish universal semantic accuracy.
